description_excerpt: About Us DHL Supply Chain is the world’s #1 contract logistics provider and part of DHL Group, connecting people and businesses across more than 220 countries and territories. In Vietnam, we combine global expertise with a strong local presence to deliver innovative supply chain solutions. Most importantly, we invest in our people, creating an inclusive culture where young talent can learn, grow and become tomorrow’s leaders.
